visual_description: A heavy-duty, open-reel tape measure. The frame is high-impact orange plastic with a large foldable winding crank. The tape itself is yellow steel with black and red metric markings. A portion of the tape is pulled out, showing the '0' hook end.

constraints.anatomy: Open-reel surveyor style (not a small pocket tape measure).
constraints.background: Isolated on a 50% grey studio floor with high-contrast contact shadows.
